import pandas as pd

# Define source file path
source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_13/test_0.csv"

# Define output file path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_13/target_multisource_cot.csv"

# Load source data
df_source = pd.read_csv(source_path)

# Group by 'sex' and 'smoker' and calculate average tip_pct
df_target = (
    df_source
    .groupby(['sex', 'smoker'], as_index=False)
    .agg({'tip_pct': 'mean'})
)

# Optional: sort by sex and smoker for consistent output
df_target = df_target.sort_values(by=['sex', 'smoker']).reset_index(drop=True)

# Save to CSV
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
